name: molecule-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Molecule (`molecule`), the testing framework for Ansible roles, playbooks and
collections. It loads scenario configuration (`molecule.yml`, base config files, environment variable substitution),
runs each subcommand's ordered sequence of actions (dependency, create, prepare, converge, idempotence, verify,
destroy, ...) through `ansible-playbook`, and generates the inventory, `ansible.cfg`, environment and state that those
runs use, together with dependency installation, verifiers and the end-of-run report.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is the src/molecule/ package. The documentation in scope is: README.md,
docs/configuration.md, docs/workflow.md, docs/usage.md, docs/execution.md, docs/ansible-native.md,
docs/pre-ansible-native.md, docs/faq.md, docs/guides/parallel.md, docs/guides/sharing.md, docs/guides/monolith.md,
and the module, class and function docstrings of the Python modules under src/molecule/.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples. In-package code comments are only supporting
evidence; when they conflict with the documentation, follow the documentation.
